info.name: Nginx version detect
author: philippedelteil
daffainfo
info.description: Some nginx servers have the version on the response header. Useful when you need to find specific CVEs on your targets.

curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 13_2) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.3 Safari/605.1.15' 'https://pentest-ground.com:4280'
